replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hey ShouDi,

Unfortunately, it is not allowed to combat/void log in any circumstances. Although you may have been lagging, you should have waited until your death was completed to rejoin the server. Since your tempban is only a few days and it is valid, I will not appeal your ban. 

Regards,
Qinn | Senior Moderator
